answer.reason: Beyond appearing in lists, the verses state that Eshtemoa was given with its suburbs to the sons of Aaron and that David sent it a share of the spoil.

clauses.english: was given with its suburbs to the priests, the children of Aaron
clauses.quote: And Jattir with her suburbs, and Eshtemoa with her suburbs,

clauses.english: received a present from David out of the spoil of his enemies
clauses.quote: Behold a present for you of the spoil of the enemies of the LORD

doubts: JOS 15:50 spells it Eshtemoh and is only a town list, so it was not used.
1CH 4:17 and 1CH 4:19 name Eshtemoa as a person (Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa; Eshtemoa the Maachathite), so they were left out.
1CH 6:57 repeats the gift to the priests and was not cited separately.
